name: Ghana requirements
description: Cybersecurity and data-protection requirements drawn from Ghanaian law and CSA directives. Project-derived paraphrase, not an official CSA control catalogue.
status: DRAFT - not yet reviewed by a supervisor or lawyer. Not legal advice.

tiers.label: Incident reporting
tiers.note: "Institution" is not defined in Act 1038; scope needs confirmation.

sources.name: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)

requirements.title: Report incidents within 24 hours
requirements.requirement: The person in charge of an institution must report a cybersecurity incident to the relevant Sectoral CERT, or to the National CERT, within 24 hours of detecting it. Non-compliance carries an administrative penalty.
instruments: Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you report cybersecurity incidents to your Sectoral CERT or CERT-GH within 24 hours of detecting them?

requirements.title: Report to the National CERT if no Sectoral CERT
requirements.requirement: An institution not affiliated to a designated Sectoral CERT reports to the National CERT through the national cybersecurity incident point of contact.
instruments: Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: If you have no Sectoral CERT, do you know how to report an incident to the National CERT (CERT-GH) and have a named person who does so?

requirements.title: Register with the Data Protection Commission
requirements.requirement: Register with the Data Protection Commission before processing personal data.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Are you registered with the Data Protection Commission?

requirements.title: Apply the eight data protection principles
requirements.requirement: Apply the eight data protection principles (accountability, lawfulness of processing, specification of purpose, compatibility of further processing, quality of information, openness, data security safeguards, data subject participation); process lawfully, reasonably and without infringing privacy; comply with a foreign data subject's home law where data comes from abroad.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you have documented responsibility and procedures so that personal data is processed lawfully, reasonably and in line with the eight principles?

requirements.title: Process only what is necessary and relevant
requirements.requirement: Process personal data only if the purpose is necessary, relevant and not excessive.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you collect and keep only the personal data you actually need?

requirements.title: Obtain consent or rely on a listed ground
requirements.requirement: Do not process without the data subject's prior consent unless a listed ground applies (contract, law, legitimate interest, etc.); stop processing when a data subject validly objects.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you have a lawful basis or consent for each use of personal data, and a way to stop processing when someone objects?

requirements.title: Collect data directly from the person
requirements.requirement: Collect personal data directly from the data subject, except in the listed cases.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you collect personal data directly from the person it concerns unless a permitted exception applies?

requirements.title: Collect for a specific, lawful purpose
requirements.requirement: Collect for a specific, explicitly defined, lawful purpose related to your functions.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Is each purpose for which you collect personal data specific, defined and lawful?

requirements.title: Tell people why data is collected
requirements.requirement: Make the data subject aware of the purpose of collection and of the collection details (nature of the data, who is collecting, whether supplying it is mandatory, etc.).
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you tell people what you collect, why, who is collecting it and whether providing it is mandatory?

requirements.title: Retention limits and secure disposal
requirements.requirement: Do not keep personal data longer than necessary; delete, destroy or de-identify at the end of the retention period, in a way that prevents reconstruction.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you have retention periods and securely delete or de-identify personal data when they expire?

requirements.title: Keep further use compatible with the purpose
requirements.requirement: Keep further processing compatible with the original purpose.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you check that any new use of personal data fits the purpose it was collected for?

requirements.title: Keep personal data accurate and up to date
requirements.requirement: Keep personal data complete, accurate, up to date and not misleading.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you keep personal data accurate and up to date?

requirements.title: Technical and organisational protection measures
requirements.requirement: Take appropriate, reasonable technical and organisational measures to prevent loss, damage or unauthorised destruction of personal data, and unlawful access or processing.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you have technical and organisational safeguards protecting personal data from loss, damage and unauthorised access?

requirements.title: Identify risks to personal data
requirements.requirement: Identify reasonably foreseeable internal and external risks to personal data and establish safeguards against them.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you identify the risks to the personal data you hold and put safeguards in place against them?
isoNotes: risk-assessment method itself sits in ISO/IEC 27001 cl. 6.1.2, outside 27002

requirements.title: Verify safeguards work and keep them updated
requirements.requirement: Regularly verify that the safeguards are effectively implemented, and keep them updated as new risks or deficiencies appear.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you regularly test that your safeguards work and update them when risks change?

requirements.title: Follow accepted information security practice
requirements.requirement: Observe generally accepted information security practices and procedure, and any industry or professional rules.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you follow a recognised information security standard or good-practice framework?

requirements.title: Bind data processors to security measures
requirements.requirement: Ensure any data processor you use complies with the security measures; use a written contract requiring confidentiality and security; a processor abroad must comply with Ghana's laws.
requirements.source: Act 843 s.30 (also s.29 for processors: act only on the controller's authority, keep data confidential)
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do your suppliers who handle personal data have written contracts requiring confidentiality and security, and do you check them?

requirements.title: Notify a personal-data breach
requirements.requirement: On reasonable grounds to believe personal data has been accessed or acquired by an unauthorised person, notify the Commission and the data subject as soon as reasonably practicable after discovery; restore the integrity of the system; give the data subject enough information to protect themselves. (Notification may be delayed if security agencies or the Commission say it would impede a criminal investigation.)
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you have a process to notify the Data Protection Commission and affected people promptly after a personal-data breach?

requirements.title: Respect data subjects' rights
requirements.requirement: Respect data subjects' rights of access to their personal data and to have it corrected.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Can people ask what personal data you hold about them and have errors corrected?

requirements.title: Restrict special personal data
requirements.requirement: Do not process "special personal data" except where the Act allows.
instruments: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: If you handle special categories of personal data, do you have the required justification and extra protection?

requirements.title: Notify the CSA of ownership change
requirements.requirement: Inform the CSA within seven days of any change in legal ownership of a registered CII.
instruments: Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: If ownership of the infrastructure changes, do you inform the CSA within 7 days?

requirements.title: Have the CII audited
requirements.requirement: Cause an audit of the CII to be performed.
instruments: Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Is your critical information infrastructure audited?

requirements.title: Submit the audit report to the CSA
requirements.requirement: Submit a copy of the audit report to the CSA.
instruments: Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you submit each audit report to the CSA?

requirements.title: Cybersecurity policy for the CII
requirements.requirement: Develop and implement a cybersecurity policy that addresses CII risks, consistent with international best practice for the sector.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you have an implemented cybersecurity policy covering your CII risks and sector best practice?

requirements.title: Comply with CSA policy directives
requirements.requirement: Implement and comply with any specific policy directive issued or approved by the CSA.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you implement and comply with policy directives issued or approved by the CSA?

requirements.title: Appoint a senior accountable officer
requirements.requirement: Appoint an accountable officer of senior management rank with a proactive approach to cybersecurity governance, policy and strategy.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Have you appointed a senior accountable officer for cybersecurity governance?

requirements.title: Board approval of the policy
requirements.requirement: The cybersecurity policy is approved by the Board or Directors.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Has your board or directors approved the cybersecurity policy?

requirements.title: Annual policy review
requirements.requirement: Review the approved policy at least once a year, in light of sector risks and threats.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you review the policy at least annually?

requirements.title: Policy covers data protection
requirements.requirement: The policy addresses data protection consistent with Act 843.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Does the policy cover data protection in line with the Data Protection Act?

requirements.title: Identify, classify and catalogue CII assets
requirements.requirement: Identify, classify and catalogue all CII assets.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you have a classified inventory of all CII assets?

requirements.title: Control access to CII systems
requirements.requirement: Control and manage access to CII systems and services.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Is access to CII systems controlled and managed?

requirements.title: Manage insider, customer and supplier risk
requirements.requirement: Implement measures to mitigate cyber risk from employees, customers, suppliers, service providers and other third parties.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you manage cyber risk from staff, customers, suppliers and other third parties?

requirements.title: Security-screen personnel
requirements.requirement: Security-screen all personnel who handle CII information or data.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Are personnel who handle CII data security-screened?

requirements.title: Awareness and training for all staff
requirements.requirement: Provide an appropriate level of cybersecurity awareness and training to all employees.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do all employees receive cybersecurity awareness and training?

requirements.title: Security monitoring and detection
requirements.requirement: Implement security monitoring and a response process for timely detection of incidents.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you monitor for and respond to incidents targeting the CII in a timely way?

requirements.title: Physical security of CII systems
requirements.requirement: Implement physical security for CII systems and their dependent assets and systems.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Are CII systems and their dependencies physically protected?

requirements.title: Resilience against equipment failure
requirements.requirement: Implement infrastructure and cybersecurity measures to mitigate equipment failure, including maintenance and software updates.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you maintain equipment and apply software updates to prevent failures?

requirements.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery
requirements.requirement: Develop, regularly test and update a business continuity and disaster recovery plan that supports incident response and redundancy.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you have a tested, current business continuity and disaster recovery plan?

requirements.title: Quarterly cybersecurity risk assessment
requirements.requirement: Conduct a quarterly cybersecurity risk assessment to identify existing vulnerabilities.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you assess cybersecurity risk and vulnerabilities every quarter?

requirements.title: Yearly cybersecurity audit
requirements.requirement: Conduct yearly cybersecurity audits in compliance with the Directive and Act 1038.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you conduct a cybersecurity audit every year?

requirements.title: Maintain a cybersecurity risk register
requirements.requirement: Create and keep a cybersecurity risk register cataloguing and profiling the risks.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you keep a cybersecurity risk register?

requirements.title: Take part in CSA exercises
requirements.requirement: Conduct and participate in exercises with the CSA and other CII sectors to test readiness to respond to incidents.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you take part in incident-readiness exercises with the CSA and other sectors?

requirements.title: Adopt international best practice
requirements.requirement: Adopt relevant international cybersecurity best practices, frameworks and standards approved by the CSA.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you adopt international best practices and standards approved by the CSA?

requirements.title: Source-code escrow for critical systems
requirements.requirement: Keep the source code of critical systems in escrow.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Is the source code of your critical systems held in escrow?

requirements.title: Investigate and mitigate incidents
requirements.requirement: In an incident, investigate, report and mitigate the impact according to the cybersecurity standards required by the CSA.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you investigate, report and mitigate incidents to the standards the CSA requires?

requirements.title: Report all incidents to the CERT
requirements.requirement: Report all cybersecurity incidents to the relevant Sectoral CERT, or directly to CERT-GH, within 24 hours of becoming aware.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you report every incident within 24 hours? (Same rule as T1A-01; for a CII owner it is both a general and a CII duty.)

requirements.title: Point of contact for incidents
requirements.requirement: Establish a Point of Contact for reporting incidents and receiving cybersecurity information, including sector security advisories.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you have a named point of contact for reporting incidents and receiving advisories?

requirements.title: Disclose vulnerabilities found in audits
requirements.requirement: Disclose and report any vulnerability found through internal or external audits or assessments within 72 hours.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you report vulnerabilities found in audits within 72 hours?

requirements.title: Submit audits and risk register to the CSA
requirements.requirement: Submit copies of reports on audits, the risk register and cybersecurity activities as the Directive requires.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you submit audit, risk-register and activity reports to the CSA as required?

requirements.title: Allow CSA audit access
requirements.requirement: Allow the CSA (or its authorised auditor) to audit or confirm audit activity.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you cooperate with CSA audits and inspections?

requirements.title: Communicate planned significant changes
requirements.requirement: Communicate any planned significant change to the CII (design, configuration, security or operation affecting availability of service to the CSA) before final board approval.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you tell the CSA about planned significant changes before they are approved?

requirements.title: Seek CSA clearance for organisational change
requirements.requirement: Seek clearance from the CSA at least one month before any major organisational change in operation, personnel or infrastructure.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you seek CSA clearance a month before major organisational changes?

requirements.title: Comply with additional CSA directives
requirements.requirement: Comply with any additional directive the CSA issues, without notice. Non-compliance attracts sanctions under the Second Schedule of Act 1038.
instruments: Directive for the Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure (CSA, effective 1 Oct 2021)
requirements.assessmentQuestion: Do you comply promptly with additional CSA directives?

openQuestions.finding: No general organisational standards were found beyond the CII Directive and the licensing regime. The CSA must be asked directly.

Not defined in Act 1038, the Interpretation Act or the Constitution. The Cybersecurity (Amendment) Bill 2025 (not enacted as of September 2026) proposes changes to s.47 and s.59, so the ambiguity remains in force.
Supervisor as first reviewer; an ISO 27001 Lead Auditor in Ghana for production-grade validation.
